Name: Jaazaniah, Son of Azur
Summary: Jaazaniah, son of Azur, was one of the twenty-five princes at the east gate of the temple whom Ezekiel saw in vision devising mischief and giving wicked counsel in Jerusalem; God told Ezekiel to prophesy against them, and Pelatiah son of Benaiah fell dead as he prophesied. He is a different man from Jaazaniah son of Shaphan and Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah.
KeyStory: Ezekiel saw Jaazaniah son of Azur among the princes at the east gate, and God commanded him to prophesy against the men who devised mischief in the city.
LifeLesson: Wicked counsel at the gate of God's house is judged at the gate of God's house.
